modern: Whatever the universal nature brings to each thing is for the good of that thing. And it is for its good at the time when nature brings it.
original: That is for the good of each thing, which the universal nature brings to each. And it is for its good at the time when nature brings it.

explained.summary: Whatever the nature of the universe brings to something is good for it, and good at the very moment it arrives. Marcus is asking himself to trust the timing of events as well as the events themselves, instead of wishing they had come later, sooner or not at all.
